text:
Ice Shove Along Shorelines:

🌊Wind and waves can compress floating ice into a moving pack

🌊Pressure spreads through the ice field, so the whole edge can behave like one rigid mass

🌊That lets the ice ride up onto land and stack against barriers, railings, and walkways

🌊In a connected sheet, pressure does not stay polite
